```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 7.5, fig.height = 4.8, dpi = 120)
P = params$parts
tab = function(d, digits = 4) {
  if (is.null(d) || !nrow(d)) return(invisible(NULL))
  d[] = lapply(d, function(v) if (is.numeric(v)) signif(v, digits + 1) else v)
  if (exists("nice_names")) names(d) = nice_names(names(d))
  knitr::kable(d, row.names = FALSE)
}
pm = function(m, s, d = 2) if (is.na(s)) sprintf(paste0("%.", d, "f"), m) else sprintf(paste0("%.", d, "f ± %.", d, "f"), m, s)
```

This report covers every tab of ElectroFast that had data loaded when it was made. Tabs without data are left out.

## Settings

```{r}
s = P$settings
tab(data.frame(Setting = names(s), Value = vapply(s, function(v) paste(v, collapse = ", "), "")))
```

```{r, results = "asis", eval = !is.null(P$ecsa)}
cat("## ECSA\n\n")
r = P$ecsa$table
cat(sprintf("The electrochemically active surface area is %.4f cm² (charge %.2f µC, roughness factor %.2f).\n\n",
            r[["ECSA (cm²)"]], r[["Q (µC)"]], r[["Roughness factor"]]))
```

```{r, eval = !is.null(P$ecsa)}
print(P$ecsa$plot)
tab(P$ecsa$table)
```

```{r, results = "asis", eval = !is.null(P$cal)}
cat("## ISE calibration\n\n")
s = P$cal$res$summary
cat(sprintf("Over %d day(s), the slope over the fitted standards (%s) was %s mV/decade, %.1f%% of the Nernstian %.2f. R² ranged from %.4f to %.4f.\n\n",
            s$days, s$range, pm(s$slope_mean, s$slope_sd), s$pct_nernst, P$cal$res$S, s$r2_min, s$r2_max))
if (!is.null(P$cal$bg)) {
  b = P$cal$bg$summary
  cat(sprintf("The background-corrected fit to all standards gave %s mV/decade (%.1f%% of Nernstian), with an effective background of %.2g M.\n\n",
              pm(b$slope_mean, b$slope_sd), b$pct_nernst, b$b_bkg_mean))
}
cat("### Calibration plot\n\n")
```

```{r, eval = !is.null(P$cal)}
print(P$cal$plot)
```

```{r, results = "asis", eval = !is.null(P$cal)}
cat("### Each day\n\n")
print(tab(P$cal$res$per_day[, c("day", "n", "from_M", "to_M", "slope_mV_dec", "intercept_mV", "r2", "pct_nernst")]))
if (!is.null(P$cal$cmp)) {
  c2 = P$cal$cmp$summary
  cat(sprintf("\n\nSecond range: %s mV/decade (%.1f%% of Nernstian), R² %.4f to %.4f.\n\n", pm(c2$slope_mean, c2$slope_sd), c2$pct_nernst, c2$r2_min, c2$r2_max))
}
if (!is.null(P$cal$bg)) { cat("\n\n### Background-corrected fit, each day\n\n"); print(tab(P$cal$bg$per_day)) }
cat("\n\n### Steps between neighbouring standards\n\n")
print(tab(P$cal$steps))
cat("\n\n### Files used\n\n")
print(tab(P$cal$std[, intersect(c("file", "day", "letter", "conc_M", "include", "note"), names(P$cal$std))]))
```

```{r, results = "asis", eval = !is.null(P$rt)}
cat("## Reading time\n\n")
g = P$rt$suggest
if (!is.null(g)) cat(if (is.na(g$read_s)) sprintf("No reading time reached the chosen share of settled standards (best %.0f%%).\n\n", 100 * g$share_settled)
                     else sprintf("The suggested reading time is %d s, by which %.0f%% of the %d fitted standards had settled.\n\n", as.integer(g$read_s), 100 * g$share_settled, g$fitted_standards))
sp = P$rt$slopes$spread
if (!is.null(sp)) {
  cat(sprintf("From %d s on, the slope changed by at most %.2f mV/decade on any day.", as.integer(P$rt$slopes$from_s), max(sp$spread_mV_dec)))
  fl = sp$day[sp$flagged]
  cat(if (length(fl)) sprintf(" Days changing by more than %g mV/decade: %s.\n\n", P$rt$slopes$flag_mV, paste(fl, collapse = ", ")) else " No day was flagged.\n\n")
}
```

```{r, eval = !is.null(P$rt)}
print(P$rt$plot)
tab(P$rt$slopes$spread)
```

t = P$prec$cal$table

## Methods and references

- ISE calibration: least-squares fit of EMF against −log a (Davies activities) or −log c, day by day.
- Background-corrected fit: E = E0 + S log(x + b) (Dagar et al., Sens. Actuators B 2026, 468, 140650).
- Selectivity: IUPAC fixed interference and separate solution methods (Umezawa et al., Pure Appl. Chem. 2000, 72, 1851).
- Precision: linear mixed model with day as a random effect (Carnoli et al., Anal. Chim. Acta 2024, 1304, 342444).
- ECSA: gold oxide reduction charge with 390 µC/cm² (Trasatti and Petrii, 1991).
- Techniques: the equations and their sources are listed in the app's Equations tab.
